thesis: AI-driven HBM/DRAM supercycle is contract-protected and structurally better than prior cycles, but the stock is up ~9x off lows and already prices peak-cycle euphoria; small starter position sized for optionality, not conviction.

Best AI franchise on the Street is priced worst relative to its own guide: 45x trailing EBITDA vs SK Hynix 7.7x, ~20x forward on consensus that embeds the >$100bn FY27 AI promise, zero Sell ratings, and a demonstrated -14% reaction to a hold-the-guide print (June 3-4). Short sized for reaction-function optionality ahead of Sept 2 print.
